parsed.note_claim: Não há confirmação de mídia sul-coreana sobre negociações para encerramento das atividades do BLACKPINK; são rumores não verificados de fãs.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: But is the claim true? No. Neither YG Entertainment nor any of the BLACKPINK members has announced the group's disbandment. As of now, BLACKPINK remains together.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly states the disbandment claim is false and no announcement has been made, substantiating the note's assertion that there is no confirmation and the rumors are unverified.
